d: The Driver / Messenger is responsible for providing safe and efficient transportation services for company personnel, documents, materials, and goods. The role includes delivering and collecting official documents from government authorities, customers, suppliers, banks, and other organizations while ensuring compliance with company procedures and traffic regulations.
q: High School certificate or equivalent preferred
Minimum 2 years of driving experience in Bahrain
Good knowledge of Bahrain roads, business districts, and government offices
Experience dealing with government authorities and document processing is an advantage
Basic English communication skills; Arabic knowledge is an added advantage
Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with customers, suppliers, and government officials
Good organizational skills and attention to detail
Clean driving record and strong safety awareness
r: li
Safely operate company vehicles for the transportation of personnel, documents, and materials
li
Deliver and collect official documents, parcels, and correspondence from customers, suppliers, banks, government offices, and other stakeholders
li
Handle transactions and submissions with government authorities, including LMRA, GOSI, municipalities, customs authorities, ministries, and other regulatory bodies as required
li
Ensure timely collection and delivery of documents, invoices, purchase orders, permits, and other company-related materials
li
Maintain accurate records of deliveries, collections, and trips performed
li
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure the assigned vehicle is maintained in a clean and roadworthy condition
li
Monitor vehicle service schedules and notify the supervisor of maintenance requirements
li
Assist administrative departments with external errands and operational support activities
li
Ensure the confidentiality and security of company documents and information
li
Report accidents, vehicle defects, traffic violations, or operational issues to the supervisor immediately
li
Support office and operational departments with additional duties as assigned

d: A leading insurance company is seeking an experienced legal professional to provide legal advice, manage legal risks and support its business activities.
q: Local candidates with at least 10 years of legal experience.
Background in insurance, banking or telecommunications; insurance and IRU experience preferred.
Strong experience in contracts, litigation, governance and legal advisory work.
Ability to lead a legal function and advise senior stakeholders.
Strong Arabic and English legal drafting and communication skills.
r: li
Provide legal advice to management and business departments on insurance, corporate, commercial and employment matters.
li
Draft, review and negotiate contracts, agreements and other legal documents to protect the company’s interests.
li
Advise on applicable Kuwait laws and Insurance Regulatory Unit (IRU) requirements, working closely with Compliance and other relevant functions.
li
Monitor legal and regulatory developments, assess their impact and recommend changes to contracts, policies and procedures.
li
Manage litigation, disputes and settlements, including coordinating with external lawyers and monitoring case progress.
li
Support corporate governance matters, including reviewing board and shareholder documentation and company policies.
li
Identify legal risks associated with business initiatives, products and transactions, and recommend practical solutions.
li
Maintain accurate legal records and provide management with updates on significant matters.
li
Supervise and develop legal team members where applicable to the appointed level.

d: We are looking to appoint an experienced, well-qualified and dedicated Maths Teacher.

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the reputable co-educational international schools in the Eastern Province. BISAK recognises that its most important investment is in the quality of its teachers. Working as a member of a cohesive team, you will lead, support, and promote an inclusive culture in your classroom that focuses on growth, purpose, and a sense of belonging. We are seeking someone with a genuine commitment to putting our pupils first.

BISAK is a well-established school where high-quality lessons based on the English National Curriculum are taught, while also including an international flavour incorporating the interests and needs of our multi-cultural community.
BISAK is a not for profit British School.
Benefits For The Successful Candidate Include
A competitive salary which is tax-free
Accommodation or a housing allowance aligned with your personal family circumstances
A spacious and modern, innovative teaching and learning environment
Supportive line management and access to generous professional development training
Opportunities to link with other subject areas in school

The British International School, Al Khobar is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The successful applicant will be subject to a police check, references and other checks as required to work in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
